blind_spots.title: pytest.mark.integration unregistered
blind_spots.detail: test_wheel_cli_version_smoke.py and test_release_readiness_gate_installed_wheel.py both use pytestmark = pytest.mark.integration. The mark is not registered in [tool.pytest.ini_options] markers. PytestUnknownMarkWarning appears in every run. Cannot filter with -m integration without registration.

blind_spots.title: scripts/coverage_gate.py never triggered in CI
blind_spots.detail: 5 modules currently fail their per-module coverage thresholds. CI uploads coverage.xml as artifact but no workflow enforces the 85%/90% per-module thresholds. Threshold enforcement is manual-only.

blind_spots.title: ruff target scope differs between lint.yml and release.yml
blind_spots.detail: lint.yml: 'ruff check src tests scripts'; release.yml: 'ruff check .' — different scope. A linting issue in non-src/tests/scripts files would only be caught by release.yml.

blind_spots.title: mypy flags differ between lint.yml and release.yml
blind_spots.detail: lint.yml adds --ignore-missing-imports --no-strict-optional; release.yml uses bare 'mypy src/autodev'. Both currently pass because pyproject.toml [tool.mypy] has equivalent settings. If pyproject.toml config is removed, lint.yml would still pass but release.yml might fail.

blind_spots.title: No Python 3.13/3.14 in CI matrix
blind_spots.detail: test.yml matrix covers 3.10/3.11/3.12 only. Local system has Python 3.14.4 but it's not covered. requires-python = '>=3.10' so this is not a blocking concern.

python_versions.assessment: CI matrix satisfies requires-python >=3.10. No Python 3.13+ testing but not required.

findings.title: 5 coverage gate thresholds failing — not enforced in CI
findings.detail: cli.py 46.2%, replay_flow.py 61.2%, mcp_server/server.py 74.8%, mcp_server/tools.py 78.9%, a2a/transports/http.py 78.0% are all below their 85%/90% thresholds. Gate script exists but is not invoked in any CI workflow.

findings.title: pytest.mark.integration unregistered — warning emitted on every CI run
findings.detail: PytestUnknownMarkWarning emitted for test_wheel_cli_version_smoke.py and test_release_readiness_gate_installed_wheel.py on every CI run. Add markers section to [tool.pytest.ini_options].

findings.title: scripts/coverage_gate.py never invoked in CI
findings.detail: The coverage gate with per-module thresholds is defined (scripts/coverage_gate.py) but no workflow calls it. CI coverage enforcement is limited to artifact upload only.

findings.title: test_homebrew_formula_metadata.py breaks test collection on local macOS
findings.detail: Homebrew Python 3.12 has a broken pyexpat extension. Collection error prevents running any tests when this file is included. Not a CI issue (ubuntu-latest). Workaround: --ignore flag or fix the Homebrew Python 3.12 install.

findings.title: 2 test failures + 3 errors caused by pyexpat/libexpat mismatch on local Python 3.12
findings.detail: test_overall_pass_when_all_pass and test_r2_macos_info_plist_version_match_passes_with_correct_version fail locally. 3 integration tests error. All attributable to Homebrew Python 3.12 dylib symbol mismatch. Not a CI concern.

findings.title: ruff target inconsistency: lint.yml vs release.yml
findings.detail: lint.yml: 'ruff check src tests scripts'; release.yml: 'ruff check .' — coverage differs.

findings.title: mypy flags inconsistency: lint.yml vs release.yml
findings.detail: lint.yml adds --ignore-missing-imports --no-strict-optional; release.yml has bare invocation. Both pass currently due to pyproject.toml config.

findings.title: contributing.md documents ruff without scripts/ in target
findings.detail: Docs show 'ruff check src/ tests/' but CI lint.yml runs 'ruff check src tests scripts'. Minor but creates discrepancy for contributors.

findings.title: Python 3.13/3.14 not in CI matrix
findings.detail: Not a blocker. requires-python = '>=3.10' met with 3.10/3.11/3.12 matrix.

findings.title: Docker multi-arch build not locally verifiable
findings.detail: Expected limitation. CI handles amd64 smoke test + multi-arch push on ubuntu-latest with QEMU. Local Docker available but build skipped.
